response_text: {"section_id":"MA-S3","heading_text":"","section_markdown":"## Architecture details: enriching embeddings with document ID and position\n\nThe dedicated attention head constructs a document-local mask that restricts each passage's attention to other passages sharing the same document identifier, while the shared full-attention head remains unrestricted. For each batch element, the document ID vector is extracted and iterated passage by passage. Because the query embedding occupies position 0 in the concatenated sequence, each passage row index is offset by one to yield the corresponding mask-row position. The mask row is initialized to negative infinity, blocking all attention contributions. A boolean selection is then computed by comparing the passage's document identifier against every other passage's document identifier within the same batch element; the query position is unconditionally included by prepending a true value to the selection vector.
